summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its first-quarter 2026 MD&A and unaudited financial statements, along with CEO/CFO certifications and a news release. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a Canadian foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. 10-Q or earnings release. It details operating revenues, adjusted EBITDA, net earnings, segment results for Bell CTS and Bell Media, and capital management. No transactions, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or other special situations are described. This is a standard periodic report, not a special-situation event.
